subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the parenthesis.
stimulus: 0.5  10 = 5 The (a) (fluctuate) of the market price is very (b) (puzzle) to the consumers. This situation occurs because of the (c) (irresponsible) and the (d) (neglect) of the proper (e) (author). We should take note that the (f) (suffer) of this condition are (g) (main) the poor class people. The (h) (sense) quarter must come forward and make possible (i) (commend) to come out of this (j) (stable) situation.
guide_solution: Adding suffix, prefix or both (a) fluctuation (b) puzzling (c) irresponsibility (d) negligence (e) authority (f) sufferers (g) mainly (h) sensible (i) recommendations (j) unstable
